vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: mma-bridge
Version: 1.2.6

The skill bundle provides a legitimate interface for the 'Meteor Master AI' (MMA) application via the 'mma-bridge' CLI tool. It allows an AI agent to check installation status, start the application, and interact with its local API for meteor detection tasks like analyzing video files, managing data lists, and exporting results. All network activity is restricted to local health checks (127.0.0.1), and the file system interactions (reading media folders and writing temporary JSON data files) are strictly aligned with the stated purpose of meteor monitoring and analysis. No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious persistence, or harmful prompt injection was found in SKILL.md or the reference documentation.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent: it documents and instructs using a local CLI (mma-bridge) to talk to a local Meteor Master AI app and does not request unrelated secrets or install arbitrary code.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the instructions: all commands (check/start/list/post) operate on a local 'mma-bridge' CLI and a local Meteor Master AI application. The declared requirements (none) and the included reference docs align with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions direct the agent to check/install/run a local CLI and to read local reference docs and temporary registry files (e.g., {temp}/MeteorMasterAI/mma-bridge-registry) and to pass filesystem paths (videos, folders, JSON files) to mma post. This is expected for a tool that controls a local app, but it means the agent will access arbitrary local files/paths when instructed—review any file paths you provide and avoid giving sensitive file locations or credentials.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec inside the skill (instruction-only). The README notes 'npm install mma-bridge -g' as a precondition but the skill itself does not download or execute external archives. Risk depends on the external npm package, which is outside this bundle.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables or credentials. However, several API methods intentionally accept local file paths and example outputs include an RTSP URL with embedded credentials — exercise caution when supplying paths or strings that contain secrets (RTSP, proxy, or local files).
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill is not always-enabled and does not request elevated platform privileges or modify other skills. It is user-invocable and allowed to be invoked autonomously (standard), which is appropriate for a local-integration skill.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is a documentation-only bridge for a local CLI that controls Meteor Master AI. Before installing or using it: (1) verify you actually intend to use the mma-bridge npm package and inspect that package (npm page/source) before running npm install -g; (2) be aware that using the commands requires passing local file and folder paths and may read files from your system (videos, images, temp registry files) — do not pass sensitive files or credentials; (3) the example docs contain an RTSP URL with an embedded password — never reuse that kind of credential in commands you send; (4) ensure the Meteor Master AI app you install comes from a trusted source (App Store / Microsoft Store links are provided) and is the required version (>5.5.0). If you need higher assurance, request the mma-bridge package source or a signed release before installing.
